Can People Buy Plots Of Land On The Moon?
s: September 12, 2023 - The relevant provision of the OST is Article II which states: “Outer space, including the moon and other celestial bodies, is not subject to national appropriation by claim of sovereignty, by means of use or occupation, or by any other means.” · “So what?” you might say. “The OST pertains to nations. I’m not a nation, so why can’t I buy 40 acres on the Moon with a nice view of the Apollo 15 landing site?” Contrary to what you might believe, this provision absolutely prevents you from buying that gray, arid hunk of moon that you crave.
